suspicion: selected_passive_bindings covers 5 families while SelectedTraitEffectRole has 12 roles -> a package member of an omitted family could escape the atomicity check
why_rejected: Every role reachable in a recorded (arity>=2) package is one of the 10 composition slots (SpellMod x6 kinds, CriticalBlockAmount, HealingReceived, AutoAttackDamage, AutoAttackCriticalChance); all map to the 5 chained families (AutoAttackCriticalChance -> passive_critical). HasteAll, AllCriticalChance, CritChanceForCaster, MeleeAutoAttackSpeed, DamageDone/Taken, AbsorbReceived are singleton-only (counts.other rejects them in any multi-effect package) and singletons are never recorded. Safe today; latent seam only if a future composition admits them (MUT-A-044). Note: the family identity is still lost (CSA-A-01).

suspicion: selected_passive_package_source returns the first find() match; two sources could share an exact effect and the wrong package would be required
why_rejected: Recorded effects come only from sources whose every member is declared under that exact (entry,rank); a catalog family holds at most one declaration per exact effect; owner-role count must equal arity. Two entries (or two ranks) naming one provider therefore cannot both compile (MUT-A-040/041).

suspicion: compile_selected_passive_package_effects is only called from the spell-modifier compiler, so a package without a SpellMod member would be invisible to state validation
why_rejected: composition_is_admitted_by admits no multi-effect multiset without a SpellModifier role (arity 2: direct+periodic, direct+label, critbonus+block, direct+auto-damage; 3: healing+2 first-effect label; 4: Heart; 5-8 all SpellMod). Every member compiler requires all siblings declared, so the spell-modifier family is non-empty and PassiveSpellModifierPlan is compiled (modifier.rs:911-917 unconditional; passive_spell_modifier.rs:139-141). The code comment at crates/combat/src/program/selected_trait_package.rs:224-228 states the invariant accurately.

suspicion: raw-638-class bug (selected amount replaced by authored points) at another final compiler
why_rejected: All nine selected final compilers read resolved.selected_amount or the role value built from it (PL-A-002..PL-A-010); authored base points are used only for non-selected activations or fixed carriers.

suspicion: source order determines role / unknown siblings can be filtered away
why_rejected: Roles are computed per exact effect; probe holds_source_order_does_not_determine_role. Unknown siblings make the whole contract None and a source-declared but unretained effect makes the resolver refuse IncompleteEffects.
Required members are enumerated by exact source equality and matched against exact (actor, member) pairs.

suspicion: one valid actor masks another orphan actor
why_rejected: Validation iterates every bound (actor,effect) independently; probe holds_complete_actor_does_not_mask_orphan_actor.
selected_package_effects is an immutable boxed slice inside PassiveSpellModifierPlan read only during state construction; CombatState has no package field; ordinary authorities remain owners.

suspicion: declarations not atomic: one member compiles while another is undeclared
why_rejected: Each member compiler (and the provenance recorder) refuses the program unless every member is declared under the exact source; program build is all-or-nothing (probes a_selected_owner_policy.rs::holds_only_spell_modifier_member_declared_rejects, holds_only_block_member_declared_rejects).

suspicion: single-effect sole-authority path and contract path disagree on admission of a live effect
why_rejected: Both call the same selected_trait_package_contract (arity 1 always admitted) and the same classifier; the only divergence found is the missing owner policy in the raw-638 compiler (CSA-A-02), which has no live singleton.
